Landing.metadataTitle: Lazy Lands · Campaign Companion for Dungeon Masters
Landing.metadataDescription: Track every NPC, faction and consequence across sessions. Lazy Lands helps Dungeon Masters capture campaign context, validate memories, and generate session briefings, so the world remembers what your players did.

announcement.body: Under active development, with new features every week. <signup>Sign up</signup> and you'll be the first to know.

hero.badgeAudience: For DMs who actually run long campaigns
hero.title: Your campaign,<break></break><accent>without the amnesia</accent>.
hero.body: The companion that remembers every NPC, every faction and every consequence, so your next session starts from accepted memory, and the world remembers what your players did.
hero.demoCta: ✦ See it on a real campaign

pillars.title: Not a one-shot generator. It is memory.
pillars.description: Lazy Lands turns session logs into reviewable campaign continuity: what changed, who reacted, and what the Scribe may use next.

loop.label: Log
loop.title: Session VII: the warehouse fire
loop.body: The DM records what happened at the table, including consequences and private notes.

loop.label: Review
loop.title: The Scribe proposes memories
loop.body: Each suggestion explains why it matters and keeps Accept, Edit and Dismiss visible.

loop.label: Prepare
loop.title: Only accepted memory returns
loop.body: The next briefing uses confirmed context, not dismissed suggestions or private notes.

pillars.memoryPlayBody: Two party members earned Halia's favor; two damaged it. The next briefing must account for the split trust at the Miner's Exchange.

briefing.title: A briefing that reads like your own prep, only faster.
briefing.body: Not a data dump. An ordered draft you can read five minutes before the session. Always a draft: you edit it, you decide what happens.

mock.label: Briefing · Session VIII
mock.title: The Quiet Ledger
mock.synopsis: Halia Thornton calls the party to the Miner's Exchange. She knows they started the <u>warehouse fire</u>, and offers silence in exchange for one quiet job.
mock.memory: You accepted in Session VII: "Two party members earned Halia's favor; two damaged it." The Scribe built her offer around it.

steps.title: Create your campaign
steps.body: Name it, pick a system, paste the premise. The Scribe drafts your NPCs, factions and arcs for you to review, every one, before it's canon.
steps.state: Extraction review: NPCs, factions and arcs are editable before saving.

steps.title: Log each session
steps.body: After the table clears, write what happened. The Scribe proposes the memories worth keeping. You accept, edit or dismiss.
steps.state: Memory review: suggested, accepted and dismissed states stay visible.

steps.title: Prepare the next
steps.body: Hit Prepare. Get a briefing built on everything you accepted. Edit it. Print it. Run it.
steps.state: Session draft: every section stays editable before export.

philosophy.quote: The Scribe is a draft, never the author. Nothing reaches your table until you've made it canon.
philosophy.caption: The whole philosophy, in one line

cta.title: Start your first chronicle.
cta.body: Free while in early access. Start with one campaign and keep every accepted memory reviewable from the first session.

footer.madeBy: © 2026 · made by a DM tired of forgetting

Legal.cookieNoticeBody: Lazy Lands uses cookies for authentication only. No tracking, no third-party data.
Legal.localStorageNotice: This site uses local storage to remember cookie consent

cookiesPage.title: Cookie Policy
cookiesPage.intro: Lazy Lands uses only technically necessary cookies and local storage keys. We do not use advertising cookies, tracking pixels, or third-party analytics scripts. Supabase authentication uses its default project-scoped storage key because this app does not configure a custom Supabase auth storage name.
cookiesPage.exemptionBody: Under LSSI-CE Art. 22.2 (Ley de Servicios de la Sociedad de la Información y de Comercio Electrónico, art. 22.2) and its European equivalents, technically necessary cookies that are strictly required to provide a requested service do not require prior consent. All storage items listed below fall under this technical exemption.
cookiesPage.authTokenDesc: Supabase authentication session storage used by the default @supabase/ssr clients in this app. The project reference comes from the configured Supabase URL, for example sb-abcdefghijklmnopqrst-auth-token. It contains the Supabase session payload required for login continuity and authenticated requests; it is cleared on logout.
cookiesPage.consentDesc: Records whether you have acknowledged this cookie notice. Stored in localStorage. Value: "acknowledged". Persistent.
cookiesPage.announcementDesc: Records whether you have dismissed the site-wide announcement bar. Stored in localStorage. Value: "dismissed". Persistent.
cookiesPage.noTrackingBody: Lazy Lands does not load any advertising networks, social media pixels, or analytics platforms that set their own cookies. No data is shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
cookiesPage.contactBody: Questions about this policy? Contact us at <mail>contacto@danilopgon.com</mail>.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.controllerBody: The legal data controller is pending final legal review. Until a formal entity and contact channel are published, this page is a non-indexed implementation placeholder and should not be treated as final legal notice.
privacyPage.collectIntro: When you use Lazy Lands, we collect:
privacyPage.collectEmail: Email address: used for authentication and product communications.
privacyPage.collectContent: Campaign content: the notes, NPCs, factions, session logs, and other content you create inside the application. This data is yours and is only accessible to you.
privacyPage.collectTokens: Authentication tokens: technical tokens (Supabase) stored in your browser to maintain your session.
privacyPage.legalBasisBody: Processing is based on GDPR Art. 6.1.b: processing is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are party (the Lazy Lands terms of service), or in order to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract.
privacyPage.rightsIntro: Under GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacyPage.rightAccess: Right of access: request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
privacyPage.rightRectify: Right to rectification: request correction of inaccurate data.
privacyPage.rightErasure: Right to erasure: request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten").
privacyPage.rightPortability: Right to portability: receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacyPage.rightObject: Right to object: object to processing based on legitimate interests.
privacyPage.rightsContact: To exercise any of these rights before our formal contact channel is published, reach out via privacy@lazylands.app (temporary inbox, monitored during early access).
privacyPage.retentionBody: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. Deleting your account removes all campaign data. Authentication logs are retained for up to 90 days for security purposes.
privacyPage.noSharingBody: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. We use Supabase (an infrastructure provider) to store and process data; they act as a data processor under a data processing agreement.
